features.name: Vision model availability [GATE]
features.description: GATE. Send one small image to glm-5v-turbo via the z.ai endpoint. Done when: a correct description comes back. If it fails, set status=blocked, record the error in docs/DECISIONS.md, and STOP — the vision fallback claim cannot be built on this plan and that is a conversation, not something to work around with a text-only substitute.

features.name: Site reachability audit
features.description: Launch Playwright against ~5 WebVoyager sites spanning easy and hard (Cambridge Dictionary, ArXiv, GitHub, Amazon, Booking). Standard Chromium, standard user agent, NO evasion tooling. Done when: docs/DECISIONS.md holds a table of site, headless result, headed result, and what blocked it. A blocked site is a finding to report, not a problem to engineer around.

features.name: Task set decay audit
features.description: Sample ~20 WebVoyager tasks and check by hand whether each site still supports what the task asks. Done when: counts of still-valid / changed / impossible are in docs/DECISIONS.md. This decides the honest denominator and is itself a reportable result.

features.name: Task subset selection
features.description: Select ~100 tasks stratified across all 15 sites using the reachability and decay findings. Done when: tasks/subset.json exists alongside a written selection rule a reader could reproduce.

features.name: Playwright driver and action space
features.description: Implement the seven actions (click, type, scroll, navigate, back, wait, answer). Nothing site-specific. Done when: a scripted sequence completes a search on two different sites through the same code path.

features.name: Accessibility tree serializer (arm A)
features.description: CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree, filtered to interactive and meaningful nodes, with stable per-step numeric ids. Done when: on three sites, every visibly clickable primary control appears in the serialization with a usable id.

features.name: Token budget and truncation policy [MEASUREMENT]
features.description: MEASUREMENT. Count tokens per observation, apply the documented priority order, record truncation. Done when: the observation-size distribution across at least 20 pages is in docs/DECISIONS.md and the budget is chosen FROM that distribution rather than guessed. The budget is a resume number.

features.name: Episode traces
features.description: JSONL plus screenshots capturing per step: observation size, tokens in/out, chosen action, result, latency, vision trigger. Done when: an episode can be fully reconstructed from its trace alone. Traces are the deliverable — never run the benchmark without them.

features.name: Agent loop
features.description: Observe, plan, act against GLM. Strict action parsing — a malformed action is a logged failed step, not a crash. Done when: the agent completes one easy task end to end, such as a dictionary lookup or an ArXiv search.

features.name: Bounded retry and replan policy
features.description: Implement MAX_ACTION_RETRIES, MAX_REPLANS, MAX_STEPS, MAX_WALLCLOCK_MS, keeping the retry path distinct from the replan path. Done when: a forced failure (a bad element id) produces exactly one retry, then a replan, then termination within caps — verified from the trace. Know all four constants by heart; they are the substance of the resume claim.

features.name: Termination and answer extraction
features.description: The answer action ends an episode; caps end it otherwise with a recorded reason. Done when: every episode terminates with an explicit recorded reason and nothing hangs.

features.name: Deterministic vision trigger [MEASUREMENT]
features.description: MEASUREMENT. Implement the triggers from ARCHITECTURE.md — too few interactive elements, observation below a token floor, stuck detector — each logged by name so the headline percentage can be broken down by reason. Done when: a canvas-heavy page fires the trigger and a plain text page does not. 'DOM was insufficient' must be a defined condition, not a judgment call.

features.name: Vision step via glm-5v-turbo
features.description: On trigger, send the screenshot alongside the text observation. Done when: an episode that fails without vision succeeds with it, demonstrated from both traces.

features.name: Set-of-marks renderer (arm B)
features.description: Numbered bounding boxes drawn on a screenshot plus an id/label list. Done when: rendered marks align with real interactive elements across three sites. This is the second arm of the serialization ablation.

features.name: Benchmark runner
features.description: Run the subset with concurrency, per-episode wall-clock caps, resume after interruption, and full trace capture. Done when: a 10-task pilot completes, survives being interrupted and resumed mid-run, and produces traces for every episode.

features.name: LLM judge
features.description: WebVoyager judging protocol using glm-5v-turbo on the final screenshot and answer. Done when: verdicts with retained reasoning exist for the pilot run.

features.name: Human agreement sample [CREDIBILITY]
features.description: CREDIBILITY GATE. Hand-label at least 30 stratified episodes yourself, BLIND — before seeing judge verdicts. Report raw agreement and Cohen's kappa. Done when: agreement numbers are in docs/DECISIONS.md. GLM judging a GLM agent is this project's weakest point; this number is what makes the pass rate believable. Do not skip it and do not label after seeing the judge's answer.

features.name: Full subset run
features.description: All ~100 tasks. Record pass rate over attempted tasks AND over reachable tasks, separately, plus cost and latency per task. Done when: the results table carries both denominators with the difference explained.

features.name: Failure category definitions
features.description: Write the taxonomy definitions BEFORE looking at failures, separating agent failures (grounding, planning, extraction, premature-answer, loop) from non-agent failures (site-blocked, task-obsolete, infra). Done when: definitions are committed before any labeling begins.

features.name: Label every failure [HEADLINE]
features.description: HEADLINE RESULT. Assign one primary label per failed episode, working from traces. Done when: every failure is labeled, the distribution table exists, and the dominant agent failure mode is identified. This fills the last resume placeholder and is the part almost nobody else does.

features.name: Labeling self-consistency
features.description: Re-label a 20% sample after a break and measure self-agreement. Done when: self-agreement is recorded. If it is poor, the categories are badly defined — fix them and relabel rather than reporting a shaky distribution.

features.name: Serialization ablation [HEADLINE]
features.description: HEADLINE RESULT. Arm A (accessibility tree) vs arm B (set-of-marks) on the same subset: pass rate, tokens per step, latency. Done when: the results table exists. The resume names whichever wins, and the loser's number stays available for the follow-up question.

features.name: Vision on/off ablation
features.description: Same subset with the fallback disabled. Done when: the pass-rate delta is recorded alongside the trigger-rate breakdown by reason.

features.name: Trace viewer
features.description: Static HTML showing, per episode, the steps, screenshots, actions, tokens, and verdict. Done when: a stranger can open it and follow what the agent did and where it went wrong. This is the artifact to show in an interview.

features.name: README with honest limitations
features.description: Numbers, method, subset selection rule, judge agreement, failure distribution, and a limitations section covering live-site non-reproducibility. Done when: every number traces to docs/DECISIONS.md.

features.name: Rewrite the resume bullet
features.description: Replace all six bracketed placeholders in sarthak_resume.tex with measured values and delete the [BRACKETED PLACEHOLDERS] warning comment. Done when: no brackets remain and every number traces to a measurement in docs/DECISIONS.md.
